main_text.l: PERICOPA QUARTA.

l.i: Alterum Dei Oraculum seu responsum ad

main_text.l: AD CAPUT SECUNDUM.
equitur jam alterum Dei oraculum,
quo ad instantiam vatis responsurus,
exponit prædictam Chaldæorum im-
missionem non effecturam, ut populus justus
interea intereat, aut legis œconomia cessaret; verum se
curaturum ut, restituto populo, lex & fides maneant
usque ad Messiæ adventum, quem certo certius
tempore definito venturum affeverat; nec non ut evangelii
præconem cum doctrinâ justitiæ fidei, & salutis
impetratæ denunciatione exspectare jubet.
§. 2. Subjungit tamen huic responso novam informa-
tionem, qua videas exponi judicia variorum, regno
Dei se opponentium, eo usque progressura, donec
universa terra Deo conticesceret, atque omne
oblocquentium os occluderetur. Continet vero in se
sextuplicem accusationem, cujus singula suâ comminatione
munita incedit; concipiunturque accusati, ut se
opponentes, à quorum judiciis tandem universale esset
sub Deo, regnum decretum gubernante, silentium. Hæc populi

page.notes: Running head is printed as two parts: left "CAP. II: 1-3.", right "ILLUSTRATUS.". The second paragraph breaks at the foot of the page with "Hæc" and continues on the next page with "populi" as catchword; the word "populi" is recorded as catchword only, not repeated in the text. The word "immissionem" is hyphenated across the line end as "im-missionem"; the scan is slightly blurred at that point. "oblocquentium" and "præconem" are read as printed. Some italic words in the second paragraph are slightly blurred and their italic status is an assumption.
